title: Company: Design the Bard
description: Hold; Inspiring Melody makes a random opponent laugh and skip a turn. Healing Sonnet hurts a random opponent. Preserve song weaving as a progression direction. Source: .lore/work/games/company-of-unlikely-heroes/notes/hero-class-pitches.md. Design only.
acceptance_criteria: Compare a solo opponent with a crowd; address repeat stun and illustrate a meaningful weaving choice.
notes:
Proposed first playtest, pending Ronald’s decision: Hold by default, ordinary direct Move. Choose the song, never the listener; forecast shows one seeded random living opponent and reopening cannot reroll. Healing Sonnet: 1 damage as initial tuning. Inspiring Melody: skip next activation; after missing it the listener must get one normal opportunity to act before laughter can affect them again. Draw from eligible opponents only; no eligible listener means the forecast explains why Melody is unavailable. Solo: Melody then Sonnet rather than permanent stun. Crowd: the next Melody may interrupt someone else. Future weaving example for discussion: Melody followed by Sonnet echoes onto the previous listener; repeating Sonnet forgoes the echo. No upgrade infrastructure proposed for the base kit.
Ronald confirmed: both songs must be selectable persistent standing orders so Bard can keep performing while the direct command goes to a teammate. Hold is the default movement habit, not the only standing order. Selecting the Bard for a direct Move or another song overrides that round only. After laughter costs a listener its turn, it is immune to laughter for the following round; never refresh laughter on an already laughing listener. Inspiring Melody selects only eligible living opponents: with two opponents acting normally repeated performances alternate after the first random choice; with one, no listener on the immune round. Reopening the forecast must not reroll. Song weaving belongs to guild upgrades (mind-garage-8cf), not the initial kit.
Implement base Bard as a guild recruit under the agreed hybrid order rules. Validate standing songs, alternation, single listener immunity and direct override.
close_reason: Seventh guild recruit implemented with persistent Melody and Sonnet orders, temporary direct overrides, forecast-stable random listeners and one-round laughter immunity. Patrol, solo and two-opponent regressions verified. Song weaving tracked in mind-garage-8cf.
